notes.title: August 14 – V1.6 Patch Notes
notes.content: 1. Fixed a crash that occurred when pressing the [b]F[/b] key to rotate a building.

notes.title: V1.5 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[h3]V1.5 Update Highlights:[/h3]
[olist]
[*] Fixed a bug where buildings could not be selected.
[*] Added the ability to sell the selected building by pressing “T”.
[*] Pressing the right mouse button can now cancel a building currently under construction.
[/olist]

[h3]Control Instructions[/h3]
[list]
[*] Use W, A, S, D to move the camera.
[*] Press R to repair a selected building.
[*] Press T to sell a selected building.
[*] Press H to return to the base view.
[*] Click on the building icons on the right side to purchase.
[*] Once the icon is ready, click on it to start construction.
[*] Drag the transparent building in the field to move it.
[*] Press Spacebar to complete the construction.
[*] Press Q to cancel construction.
[*] Press F to rotate a building.
[*] Press Z to select all ground defense towers.
[*] Press X to select all anti-air defense towers.
[*] Press C to select all defense towers.
[/list]

notes.title: 🏰Territorial Defense Campaign now underway!
notes.content: [p]Attention, Commanders! The Territory Defense Campaign has begun![/p][p]TechGuardian: Territory Defense is now officially live, available at a launch price of just $6.39 for the next 10 days.[/p][p]Featuring both Defense and Assault modes—each with endless play—you’ll experience an exhilarating, nonstop battle to protect your realm.[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3456220"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45460242/fc31c43e812079f81b1c04af33638940fe346ea9.png"][/img][/p][p]And there’s more: for a limited time, you can grab the launch-discount price of TechGuardian: Territory Defense and get Parkour Assassin: Sprint Run—another hit from developer Apex Horizon—absolutely free![/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/57717"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]Own any of the games below, or just interested in them? You’ll unlock additional bundle discounts on top.[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/57642"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/57644"][/dynamiclink][/p][h3]Game Features[/h3][p]We've brought to life the game from those frequently seen ad videos! Enemy forces are invading territories. Build defense systems, launch offensives, and reclaim sovereignty! It'll immerse you in a sci - fi future war world. As a central control room commander, embark on a grand defense campaign. Combine firepower and defense units to retake controlled areas.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45460242/8550996995d45ba67ec8cdd1e4163fccf24cc67c.gif"][/img][/p][p]Defense Mode: Amidst intense firepower, defend your territory in this highly - freedom strategy game. Construct an economic system and freely build various functional units. While fending off enemies, seize new areas.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45460242/32117a7ae69dae1a873c114be82acca94a344cb1.gif"][/img][/p][p]Attack Mode: Deploy your military forces to break through enemy defenses and reclaim occupied territories. Seize the right moments and strategically deploy your fighter jets, tanks, drones, and other military equipment to seize control of enemy-held areas![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45460242/91acf4e8c5696ce483e9e8f88ea13b32dea443f7.gif"][/img][/p][p]The unit + entry/building+entry system adds more possibilities. You can freely acquire and manage different units, adding entries with various attributes and functions, sparking different combinations in campaigns.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45460242/c8e8cd96169c846f5d0e8aa582cdfe85e713c454.gif"][/img][/p][p][b]TechGuardian: Territory Defense offers multiple game modes, including single - player and infinite modes.[/b][/p][p]In single - player mode, you'll enter various campaigns and maps. You can either become the master of a fortress, defending against enemy attacks while expanding your territory, or transform into a war commander, operating military weapons to breach enemy defenses and accomplish great campaigns![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45460242/741d5ba38b251b2dd4e2d82b4f27ae7c31aa65f0.gif"][/img][/p][p]Infinite Mode provides you with a battlefield for endless combat, supporting both Infinite Defense Mode and Infinite Attack Mode. In Infinite Defense Mode, you can deploy your defenses in advance to withstand waves of endless enemies. In Infinite Attack Mode, you can prepare your military weaponry to launch a fierce assault on the enemy. Once the battle begins, it will not stop until failure.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45460242/33241af5b45440b93e3a623baa011547770b0977.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]FIGHT! CRUSH! THRILL![/b][/p]

notes.title: TechGuardian: Territory Defense — Launching August 7!
notes.content: [p]Hey everyone! Our game, TechGuardian: Territory Defense, is officially launching on August 7 at 12:00 PM (BeingJing Time).[/p][p]Inspired by those epic mobile-game ads, it delivers the thrill of massive, screen-filling battles—get ready to command armies like never before![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45460242/a5f7508701192e072675a9ca4ad4bb7cb76a1c39.png"][/img][/p][p]This is a sci-fi strategy game featuring two core modes: a defensive mode where you build turrets and expand territory, and an offensive mode where you deploy forces to break through enemy defenses. Over 30 distinct buildings and units are available, each upgradeable by editing their data entries for enhanced performance and firepower. Dive into Endless Mode and fight to the very end![/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3456220/_/"][/dynamiclink]During this time, we’ve polished the game extensively and introduced brand-new mechanics! Compared with the demo, we’re confident the final release now offers far more ways to play.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]I. Complete UI Overhaul[/b][/h3][p]We’ve rebuilt the entire interface from the ground up—it looks and feels completely fresh![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45460242/07fa02f37fbf19e3d532bbc5f04977e9537cba48.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45460242/da6e740799f4ac96ac63ade572317e4b5a632c1f.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45460242/85b4ca92110f61f200810899ba5f91bbf1ecd542.jpg"][/img]For the PC version, we’ve delivered a full-scale adaptation—every UI element and control scheme has been re-tuned for mouse & keyboard. You’ll feel the difference the moment the final build launches![/p][p][/p][h3][b]II. Introducing the brand-new Attack Mode![/b][/h3][p]The full release introduces the new Attack Mode. Like Defense Mode, it offers three difficulty tiers plus a corresponding endless offensive variant. Before each run, players must choose their unit cards from the warehouse.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45460242/93fcdd9c5be4eac22d88bbc7629758294557a9fa.jpg"][/img]In Attack Mode, your objective is to wipe out the enemy fortress. Purchase combat units, smash through their defenses, and destroy their base to clear each stage. Every structure you wreck yields resources you can spend to deploy even more units.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]III. Full English Localization[/b][/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45460242/07fa02f37fbf19e3d532bbc5f04977e9537cba48.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45460242/99859a7fcc81869c95ebe3cff803a7a0a3cf1919.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45460242/d319e4be374c517f669e69d8e2864a945debd08a.png"][/img]We’ve rolled out comprehensive English localization—every line of text and voice is now fully available in English![/p][p][/p][h3][b]IV. Full Steam Integration[/b][/h3][p]Cloud saves and achievements are here!!! Jump in and see if you can unlock them all~[/p][p][/p][p]TechGuardian: Territory Defense launches August 7—add it to your wishlist now![/p][p]Defend your territory and crush real enemies in the kind of battles those fake ads only promised.[/p]

notes.title: 《TechGuardian: Territory Defense》has now joined this year's STEAM NEXTFEST!
notes.content:
Dear Players,

Thank you for your continuous support and attention to our game! We are excited to confirm that TechGuardian: Territory Defense will be participating in this year's Steam Next Fest, taking place from February 25th to March 4th. We warmly welcome you to join us for a trial play!

This is a tower defense game inspired by the many ad videos we often come across. TechGuardian: Territory Defense DEMO is a sci-fi-themed tower defense game where you build defense towers to protect your territory and reclaim areas controlled by enemies. The game features over 30 different units, all of which can be upgraded through editing entries to achieve higher performance and firepower.

We have added five more levels to the original five planned for the DEMO version, bringing you a total of ten levels of gameplay experience!

If you encounter any issues during your trial play, or if you have any feedback or suggestions, please feel free to share your gaming experience with us in the game's review section or on the Steam Community.
Thank you once again for your support, and we hope you enjoy the game!
